artworks.title: Saints Stephen, Sixtus, and Lawrence
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: Three people standing in a row. The central figure wears a papal tiara, intricate robes, and holds a staff. The figure on the left holds a palm branch, while the one on the right holds a book and a stick. Architecture, hills, and a distant city in the background.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Angels in a Vaulted Hall
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows a family scene with a seated baby held by a woman, with two winged figures nearby. A man stands close by, and architectural elements frame the background. Above, there are images of reclining figures or cherubs within a decorative arch.

artworks.title: No se puede saber por que (One Can't Tell Why)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished lavis, drypoint and burin on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows eight individuals seated closely on a bench, each shown from head to toe. They are leaning slightly forward, with their hands in front of them holding a small cross. The people have sombre facial expressions and wear dark robes and black head coverings with a white cross. Each person has a piece of paper on their chest with illegible text. The background is grey with horizontal line patterns.

artworks.title: Disparate desordenado (Disorderly Folly)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in dramatic gestures and expressions. The scene is highly dynamic, with figures depicted in various postures interacting with one another. The composition is tightly packed, and the style is dark and atmospheric. The central figure appears to be gesturing or pointing and is surrounded by other figures with distinct, exaggerated facial expressions. The use of strong contrasts between light and shadow adds to the intensity and dramatic quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Disparate furioso (Furious Folly)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: This is a painting of figures engaged in action against a dark background. The artwork depicts figures in dynamic poses, with some crouching or leaning forward while others stand upright. Their clothing appears loose and the scene is rendered in monochrome with strong contrasts between light and shadow. The background is dark and textured. The figures are represented in an exaggerated expressionist style, emphasizing the intensity of their movements and interactions.

artworks.title: Dutch View
artworks.medium: pen and black ink heightened with white
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image displays a river scene with a perspective view from a slightly elevated position. The horizon features various distant structures and ships along the riverbanks. On the left, there is a shoreline path with people walking alongside trees. A windmill appears in the background, while larger ships are docked on the right. The sketch uses precise brushstrokes to outline figures and structures, with a monochromatic color palette of black ink on sepia-toned paper.

artworks.title: The Landscape Artist (Le paysagiste)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows an artist painting in a park landscape. The artist is seated in front of an easel, holding a paintbrush. There are trees in the background. In the foreground, the artist and his equipment are visible, along with an umbrella. On the left, a group of people is walking. The drawing effectively captures the serene ambiance of a day in nature.

artworks.title: The Tragic Actor (L'acteur tragique)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. He is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. His facial features include a mustache, beard, and focused gaze. His hair is wavy and of medium length. The man is dressed in an elaborate costume consisting of a dark cloak, tunic or jerkin with a textured appearance. He is holding a large feather or plume in his left hand. His legs are clad in closely fitting garments, and he wears shoes with buckles. Near his feet lies a rapier with a complex hilt. The background features an intricate etched design.

artworks.title: The Wool Carder (La cardeuse)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her full body visible. She is in a side view, leaning forward slightly, and focused on a task in her lap. Her facial features are detailed with a calm expression. She has her hair covered with a cloth tied around her head. The woman is wearing a long-sleeved dress with simple detailing. She is sitting in front of a spinning wheel with a stack of fabric or yarn at her feet. Her hands are working with a carding board, suggesting she is preparing fibers. The background features textured shading that suggests an indoor setting with a shelf holding several items.

artworks.title: Hail America
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle view of a shadowy waterfront scene. The Statue of Liberty is on the right, silhouetted against textured clouds in the swirling sky. The horizon is low, with a distant skyline and skyscrapers. The urban silhouette stretches across the distance. The technique used appears to be soft brushstrokes or etching, creating a moody and ethereal atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic with deep blacks and soft grays. Closest to us, there are churning waters in the harbor.

artworks.title: Rainy Night, Charing Cross Shops
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image depicts a rainy street scene from a bird's-eye view. Buildings line the street, and the brushstrokes are soft and impressionistic, capturing the effect of rain and wet surfaces with blurred outlines. The color palette consists of muted browns and warm tones. People with umbrellas and horse-drawn carriages are shown, and in the distance, there are more figures and a large tree, with streetlights illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: The West Front, Amiens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed architectural drawing of a grand cathedral, emphasizing its towering stature. The focus is on the ornate facade with elaborately carved arches, statues, and a large rose window. The drawing style includes fine, precise lines and cross-hatching to capture the cathedral's Gothic architecture. The color palette is monochrome or sepia. Steps leading up to the cathedral are visible with small human figures for scale. Smaller buildings on either side hint at a receding cityscape. The background shows a cloudy, textured sky for depth.

artworks.title: Bibi Lalouette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body profile view of a person seated, captured from the side. They are in a slightly leaned forward position, with their face turned towards the left. The person has curly hair and is wearing a loose garment with ample folds and drapery. They are holding a small black object against their chest with both hands. The background is plain. The signature "Whistler" and the year "1859" are inscribed on the lower right of the image.

artworks.title: Rag Pickers, Quartier Mouffetard, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a dimly lit room. One figure is seated with long hair, facing the standing figure who wears a wide-brimmed hat. The room is detailed with various objects on shelves and surfaces, with pillars or beams present. The artwork is framed by an elaborate border.

artworks.title: La Vieille aux Loques
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman seated, with a bonnet covering her head as she sews or knits. She wears a long dress and a shawl, surrounded by household items and fabrics. The room is filled with shadows, shelves, and various domestic objects.

artworks.title: Sketch for Madame Moitessier
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Paul Rosenberg
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a woman's upper body from just above the waist upwards. The woman is standing and is depicted in a simple, lightly drawn style. Her facial features are minimally indicated with subtle lines for the eyes, nose, and mouth, and her hair is drawn simply, framing her head in a rounded shape. She is wearing a long dress with detailed lines suggesting flowing fabric, and an additional piece of fabric is draped over her shoulders, which she holds with one hand near her chest. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the sketched figure. The sketch is done in pencil on paper, and the paper shows signs of age with slight discoloration marks.

artworks.title: Broadside: An Invitation to an Arms Competition
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored, with movable type on two joined sheets of paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historical manuscript featuring weaponry and a crest. The image portrays an old document with dense blackletter text filling much of the page. Illustrated depictions of a crossbow and an early firearm are on the left and right side of the top section, with a detailed crest in the middle. Below are a circular schematic and an illustration of a figure in colorful attire sitting on two barrels. The character is dressed in a multicolored garment and hat, resembling a style from the period. The overall appearance suggests a medieval or Renaissance manuscript with illustrations and text related to history or inventions. The style resembles that of a Renaissance artist known for manuscripts or engravings.

artworks.title: Playing Cards
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This print shows a set of playing cards in three rows of eight. The top row consists of cards with a geometric pattern resembling curving ribbons or knots with sword-like handles on each end. The cards in the middle row contain a series of circular shapes, and those in the bottom row consist of crossed lines resembling rods or batons bound together in clusters. Each card has a different number of the different objects, ranging from two to nine. The paper of the print shows signs of aging, such as wear and discoloration on its off-white surface.

artworks.title: Playing Cards
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a print that shows a set of twenty-four playing cards arranged in three horizontal rows of eight. Each card is decorated with traditional and symbolic imagery, such as crowns, flowers, swords, and people dressed in medieval attire, including some humans and some centaurs. From these images, four symbols seem to repeat several times: swords, staffs, goblets, and round plates. The cards in the bottom row all show different amounts of goblet-like shapes, from two to nine. The designs of the cards have been printed in black ink on off-white paper that is slightly damaged and discolored at the top, with the top-right image only partially visible.

artworks.title: Playing Cards
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: Printed in black ink on tan paper, twenty-four playing cards are arranged in three rows of eight that fill the horizontal sheet of this woodcut. Most of the cards in the middle and lower rows have Roman numerals in or near the upper left corner. The numbers count down from twelve, and are reversed. Each card in the top row shows a celestial entity or an imaginary being. The first card on the left shows an angel blowing a horn while hovering over a long horizontal box in which two people stand. Other cards have a stylized sun with a face, a crumbling stone tower on fire, or a man with horns and chicken feet, wearing an animal skin and holding a trident. The cards in the middle and bottom rows each feature a man or woman, many wearing crowns or headdresses, and long gowns. The only exception is one to the far right of the middle row, which shows a blindfolded, winged angel about to shoot an arrow into a woman as a man kneels opposite her. Other cards on that row include a balding, bearded man leaning on crutches; a man wearing a crown standing in a cart drawn by two horses as he holds an orb and sword; or a woman in a long gown embracing a column. The bottom row begins with a wide-eyed person wearing a cone-shaped crown decorated by two rows of zigzags. Others show men or women wearing crowns and holding orbs and scepters, a man dressed as a jester, or a man holding a sword. There are losses on the card to the left in the center row, so that image is incomplete.

artworks.title: Le matin
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image features several boats docked near the water, with large sails visible on the right side. The horizon shows white cliffs meeting the sea in the distance. The painting includes a mix of smooth and textured brushstrokes, creating a realistic effect. The color palette consists of muted grays and browns, evoking a serene morning atmosphere. The sky has a few clouds painted across it, adding to the tranquil ambiance.

artworks.title: Rue du gros-horloge, Rouen
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The etching depicts a street scene with a grand clock tower in the distance. People in historical attire are engaged in various activities along the bustling street, which is lined with vendors and buildings. The intricate facades and windows of the buildings add depth to the image. Fine, detailed brushstrokes capture the texture of the scene, while a monochromatic color palette creates a timeless quality. The sky appears overcast.

artworks.title: L'Infirmerie de l'hospital de la Charite de Paris
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is an image of a hospital infirmary. It depicts a long hall with tall ceilings and rows of beds along both sides, separated by curtains. In the foreground, there is a group of individuals around a table with dishes. Beams and lighting fixtures accentuate the perspective, with stone or ceramic urns placed on the panel between the walls. The text at the top identifies the location as "L'infirmerie de l'Hospital de la Charité de Paris."

artworks.title: The Cobbler
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior setting. Footwear is displayed in the foreground, while figures engage in various activities like stitching and discussing at a counter. A table with ornate detailing is at the center left, and a lattice structure separates the workspace from a background area with more footwear and possibly earthenware items. The border is decorated, suggesting a historical or allegorical context.
